required_operator_rules: Production claims require deploy_target and verification_evidence.
Payment and wallet executions require provider_ref and must not contain raw card data, CVV/CVC, private keys, seed phrases, or raw secrets.
All agent work must return an artifact or receipt.
deployment_prompt_for_claude_or_cloud: Deploy Agent Pocket under https://beta.pocketnova.app/agents/. Mount web/agent-pocket-console/index.html as the console, expose sdk/pocket-agent-client.js, and route agent tasks, production claims, data exports, payments, and wallet actions through explicit operator approval and receipt creation. Do not infer execution state from chat text.
